mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity * m.price), 0) FROM scm_inventory i LEFT JOIN scm_material m ON i.material_id = m.id

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, m.name AS materialName, i.quantity AS currentQty FROM scm_inventory i LEFT JOIN scm_material m ON i.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN scm_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id ORDER BY i.quantity ASC

SELECT w.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity * m.price), 0) AS value FROM scm_inventory i LEFT JOIN scm_material m ON i.material_id = m.id RIGHT JOIN scm_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id GROUP BY w.id, w.name
